record.bible_text: And it came to pass a long<WH07227> time<WH03117> after<WH0310> that the LORD<WH03068> had given rest<WH05117><WTH8689> unto Israel<WH03478> from all their enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> round about<WH05439>, that Joshua<WH03091> waxed old<WH02204><WTH8804> <FI>and<Fi> stricken<WH0935><WTH8804> in age<WH03117>. <RF>stricken...: Heb. come into days<Rf>

That ye come<WH0935><WTH8800> not among these nations<WH01471>, these that remain<WH07604><WTH8737> among you; neither make mention<WH02142><WTH8686> of the name<WH08034> of their gods<WH0430>, nor cause to swear<WH07650><WTH8686> <FI>by them<Fi> , neither serve<WH05647><WTH8799> them, nor bow<WH07812><WTH8691> yourselves unto them:

When ye have transgressed<WH05674><WTH8800> the covenant<WH01285> of the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, which he commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> you, and have gone<WH01980><WTH8804> and served<WH05647><WTH8804> other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, and bowed<WH07812><WTH8694> yourselves to them; then shall the anger<WH0639> of the LORD<WH03068> be kindled<WH02734><WTH8804> against you, and ye shall perish<WH06><WTH8804> quickly<WH04120> from off the good<WH02896> land<WH0776> which he hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> unto you.<CM>
